heading: **24 July 2026**
body:
*Manual curation of 2X Phusion Master Mix*

0.04 U/uL polymerase

2X Phusion HF Buffer

3 mM MgCl2

1.6 mM dNTPs

I need enough of this mix for about 4 X 100 PCR reactions (25 uL per reaction)

12.5 X 400 \= 5000 uL

| 200 U Phusion Polymerase | 100 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 50 mM MgCl2 | 300 uL |
| 5 X Phusion HF Buffer | 2000 uL |
| 10 mM dNTPs | 800 uL |

*lig200 PCR 2*

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **PCR 1 DNA** | **400** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1600**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.
